{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3", "test_code": "using System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task AllGeneratedFormattersAndResolversHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestProject\n{\n    public enum SampleEnum\n    {\n        First = 0,\n        Second = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyClass\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public SampleEnum EnumValue { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public struct IntKeyStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record IntKeyRecord([property: Key(0)] int Value);\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record struct IntKeyRecordStruct([property: Key(0)] int Value);\n\n    [MessagePackObject(keyAsPropertyName: true)]\n    public class StringKeyClass\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(keyAsPropertyName: true)]\n    public struct StringKeyStruct\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(keyAsPropertyName: true)]\n    public record StringKeyRecord(int Value);\n\n    [MessagePackObject(keyAsPropertyName: true)]\n    public record struct StringKeyRecordStruct(int Value);\n\n    [Union(0, typeof(UnionSubClassA))]\n    [Union(1, typeof(UnionSubClassB))]\n    public interface ISampleUnion\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionSubClassA : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int A { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class UnionSubClassB : ISampleUnion\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string B { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestProject\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? resolverInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\");\n\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(resolverInterface);\n\n        var generatedFormatters = new List<(INamedTypeSymbol FormatterSymbol, ITypeSymbol TargetType)>();\n        var generatedResolvers = new List<INamedTypeSymbol>();\n\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources))\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRoot();\n\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                if (semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl) is not INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol)\n                {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                INamedTypeSymbol? implementedFormatter = typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.FirstOrDefault(\n                    i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface));\n                if (implementedFormatter is not null)\n                {\n                    generatedFormatters.Add((typeSymbol, implementedFormatter.TypeArguments[0]));\n                }\n\n                if (typeSymbol.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, resolverInterface)))\n                {\n                    generatedResolvers.Add(typeSymbol);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        string[] expectedTargetMetadataNames =\n        {\n            \"TestProject.SampleEnum\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyClass\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyRecord\",\n            \"TestProject.IntKeyRecordStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyClass\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyRecord\",\n            \"TestProject.StringKeyRecordStruct\",\n            \"TestProject.ISampleUnion\",\n            \"TestProject.UnionSubClassA\",\n            \"TestProject.UnionSubClassB\",\n        };\n\n        foreach (string metadataName in expectedTargetMetadataNames)\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? targetSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(metadataName);\n            Assert.NotNull(targetSymbol);\n            Assert.True(\n                generatedFormatters.Any(f => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(f.TargetType, targetSymbol)),\n                $\"Expected a generated formatter for {metadataName}.\");\n        }\n\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedResolvers);\n\n        foreach ((INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol, ITypeSymbol targetType) in generatedFormatters)\n        {\n            bool hasExcludeAttr = formatterSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n                a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n            Assert.True(\n                hasExcludeAttr,\n                $\"Generated formatter '{formatterSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' for '{targetType.ToDisplayString()}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol resolverSymbol in generatedResolvers)\n        {\n            bool hasExcludeAttr = resolverSymbol.GetAttributes().Any(\n                a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n            Assert.True(\n                hasExcludeAttr,\n                $\"Generated resolver '{resolverSymbol.ToDisplayString()}' is missing ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute.\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
